title: 第752章 加入宗门第751章 剑域天才
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 来人不仅仅有沧澜城的城主，更是有方，秦，张家三家的老祖。
阵法破碎之后，他们皆感受到了洋溢在空气中的剑气，虽然只是余韵，但是，他们无一不是强者中的强者，仅仅只是凭借余韵，也能感受个大概。
稍微感知之后，几人全都有几分震撼。
这般的剑气……
好强！
是谁出手了？
虽然来时匆匆，但是，他们定睛一看，也不难发现，事情已经终结。
空气中逸散着的这一股灵力剑压，甚至让他们都不由得产生了几分战栗。
这可真是……
沧澜城城主眼神扫过在场之人，一眼就看到碧空，当下心中有几分愕然，随后，毫不犹豫转头封锁住空间。
阵盘落下的一瞬间，跟在他身边的三位老祖都没能反应过来。
他们本来在商议城务，忽然听闻下人禀报，说十二重楼发生惊变，这才急匆匆一同赶来。
如今……
“鹤青琅，你这是做什么！？”
几家的长老都不约而同皱眉。
沧澜城城主鹤青琅反而一派坦然，淡淡开口：“我丹霞剑宗的长老碧空在内，且其中并无你们三大家族之人，麻烦几位陪我走这一趟，但接下来，是我沧澜城的城务私事，烦请回避。”
这番话下来，让方家的老祖都气坏了。
他直接气笑。
“鹤城主，你这般遮遮掩掩的做什么？”
“咱们打开天窗说亮话，谁不是为了刚才那剑气留下来的，你这般封锁，不让我等探查，意欲何为？”
旁边两家老祖也跟着沉声附和。
“城中出了这么大的事情，我们本就应该一起商量，鹤城主，你一个人如此作为，不好吧。”
“是啊，万一歹人还在……”
“不劳烦几位担心。”鹤青琅轻描淡写说道，“我自然会为了我所作所为负责。”
“碧空长老生死不知，我先失陪了。”
他说完，径直迈入阵盘中，将其彻底封死。
只留下原地的三位老祖。
三位老祖你看看我，我看看你。
张家的老祖直接气笑了。
生死不知？
他看，是对方想自己先探查一番，那道剑气究竟是怎么回事吧！
真当他们老眼昏花没有看见碧空在那里好好站着。
说瞎话都不知道背着人！
但是……
纵使他们清楚，鹤青琅刚才那一番话，根本就没有走心，却也没有什么别的办法。

;;
The visitor was not only the city lord of Canglan City, but also the ancestor of the Youfang, Qin, and Zhang families.
After the formation was broken, they all felt the sword energy permeating the air. Although it was just the aftertaste, they were all the strongest among the strong. They could feel it roughly just by relying on the aftertaste.
After a little perception, everyone was a little shocked.
Such sword energy...
So strong!
Who took action?
Although they arrived in a hurry, when they took a closer look, it was not difficult to find that the matter was over.
The pressure of the spiritual sword escaping in the air even made them tremble a little.
This is really...
The Lord of Canglan City glanced at the people present, and saw the blue sky at a glance. He was a little stunned at the moment, and then turned around to seal the space without hesitation.
The moment the array disk fell, the three ancestors following him were unable to react.
They were discussing city affairs when they suddenly heard a report from a servant that something unexpected happened in the twelfth floor building, so they hurried over together.
Nowadays...
"He Qinglang, what are you doing!?"
The elders of several families all frowned in unison.
The Lord of Canglan City, He Qinglang, on the other hand, was calm and said calmly: "My elder Bi Kong from the Danxia Sword Sect is included, and there are no members of your three major families among them. Please accompany me on this trip, but what follows is my private city affairs in Canglan City, so please stay away."
These words made the ancestor of the Fang family very angry.
He laughed angrily.
"City Lord Crane, why are you so secretive?"
"Let's open the skylight and tell the truth. Who didn't stay because of the sword energy just now? What do you want to do by sealing it off like this and not allowing me to investigate?"
The ancestors of the two families nearby also echoed in a deep voice.
"Such a big thing happened in the city. We should have discussed it together. Lord He, it's not good for you to do this alone."
"Yes, if the bad guys are still there..."
"I won't bother you to worry about it." He Qinglang said lightly, "I will naturally take responsibility for what I do."
"I don't know whether Elder Bi Kong is alive or dead, so I'll excuse you now."
After he finished speaking, he stepped straight into the array and sealed it completely.
Only the three ancestors were left in place.
Three ancestors, you look at me and I look at you.
The ancestor of the Zhang family laughed angrily.
Don’t know whether life or death?
He saw that the other party wanted to investigate first, what was going on with that sword energy?
It's as if they were so blind that they didn't see Bi Kong standing there.
You don't even know you are behind someone's back when you tell lies!
But...
Even though they knew that what He Qinglang just said was not intentional at all, there was no other way.
